- Price: $49 USD one-time
- Type: downloadable developer toolkit for evidence-led website readiness audits

- Free evidence-led method: https://cekuu35.github.io/evidence-led-website-audit/
- Free interactive scorecard: https://cekuu35.github.io/evidence-led-website-audit/scorecard.html
- Scorecard behavior: 12 evidence-gated checks totaling 100 points; unknown answers receive 0; JSON and Markdown export run locally in the browser
- Scorecard privacy: no signup, file upload, website crawl, backend, or saved audit data
- Product page: https://cengokurtoglu.gumroad.com/l/ai-ready-website-audit-kit

- Seller: built and maintained by an independent solo developer
